series_break: XLSX-2 -> XLSX-3 is a presentation/OOXML break only.

workbook.header_filter: exactly one autoFilter inside xl/tables/table1.xml with ref exactly equal to the table ref; no worksheet autoFilter
workbook.summary_location: same worksheet right of table with one blank separator column

must_have: exactly one table autoFilter with same ref

incident_origin: XLSX-2 removed the conflicting worksheet/table filter shape but also removed visible filter buttons. XLSX-3 restores exactly one table-owned autoFilter and rejects both zero-filter and duplicate-filter shapes.
